candidates.desc: A cartoon man sits in a clinic waiting room holding his swollen cheek in pain; he presses a cold pack against his jaw, groans with a toothache, and winces even harder when he tries to sip his hot coffee.

A mother and her small son enter a health clinic, check in with the smiling receptionist at the desk, and wait on yellow chairs next to an old man with a cane until a doctor in a white coat opens the door and calls the boy in.
In a hospital corridor, a teenage boy with a grey medical boot on one foot walks on two metal crutches while nurses watch behind him; he gets faster and finishes with a happy little fist pump.

In a hand-painted anime scene, a shirtless climber in a green helmet collapses onto a grassy hillside after a fall, grimacing and clutching his shoulder. A worried woman kneels beside him, touching the hurt arm as he winces in pain and holds the joint.

In an animated old apothecary, a woman squeezes the bulb of a glass dropper, draws up liquid and counts three drops into a wooden spoon. She hands the dose to a red-bearded man wrapped in a blanket, who takes it and immediately looks better.

An animated woman in a red tracksuit unwraps a bandage from her forearm, opens and closes her hand to test it, then happily reaches up to gymnastic rings and pumps her fist because the arm has healed.

In a Pixar-style park scene a jogger hobbles to a bench, pulls off his sock, and watches his hurt ankle balloon into a huge round lump; he gasps, pokes it, and presses a blue ice pack on the swelling.

A young woman sits on a couch with her feet up; one foot and ankle are visibly red and puffy compared to the other. A shocked man points at the swollen foot and presses an ice pack onto it while she winces.

A tearful young woman hugs a pillow in an armchair and talks to a grey-haired therapist who listens with a notebook. She cries, takes a tissue, gradually starts smiling, and leaves the session relieved, shaking the therapist's hand.

In a retro cartoon, a nurse shakes a glass thermometer and puts it in a sick man's mouth; the red line rockets up as his whole face glows red like a stoplight, so she dumps a bucket of ice on his head and the reading sinks back down.

A curly-haired young man sits in a living room with a big fluffy ginger cat on his lap; as he strokes it his eyes go red and streaming and he sneezes into a paper tissue; a woman in denim lifts the cat off him and carries it across the room, and he keeps sneezing and wiping his nose while she holds the cat at a distance.

A red-haired man in a green tartan shirt stands on a grassy hillside path, screwing his face up and reaching one arm back over his shoulder to rub the top of his own back, then reaching round with the other hand to press the small of his back. The clip cuts to him walking up a fern-lined dirt track with a large black rucksack on, laughing, with two other walkers on the path behind. In the last shots he gives a red-haired woman in a mustard fleece a piggyback along the same path, both of them laughing at the camera with green bracken all around.

A grey-haired man in an apron is chopping vegetables in a rustic kitchen when he catches his finger with the knife. He winces, sucks the finger, then hurries to the sink and holds it under the running tap while the water runs pink. He dries it, tears open a small plaster and wraps it around the cut fingertip while a woman keeps cooking behind him.

High on a rocky mountain path with snow peaks behind her, a hiker with a big backpack limps to a rock and sits down, pulling off her boot. She rolls the sock down to show a raised, shiny blister on the back of her heel. Her companion crouches beside her, digs a plaster out of his pack and passes it to her; she peels it open and presses it carefully over the blister before easing the sock and boot back on.

A mother and her teenage son with a grey backpack walk up to a small pink and turquoise clinic with a blue cross sign over the door and go in. Inside they stop at a reception counter, where the boy presses a bell on the countertop. They then sit down on yellow plastic chairs against the wall. Beside them an elderly man waits with both hands on a walking stick; a low table in front of them holds magazines. Notices and certificates cover the wall and a round clock hangs above. A doctor in a white coat appears in the corridor doorway and they get up.

A woman in a mint green jumper holds a glass pipette full of golden yellow oil over a tall glass of water on a kitchen counter. She squeezes the bulb and small yellow beads fall one at a time from the tip into the water, where they hang and sink as little spheres. She keeps counting them out, and the oil spreads into yellow swirls through the glass. She screws the pipette back into its brown bottle, lifts the glass, and drinks the cloudy yellow water by the window.

In a clinic a doctor in a white coat stands at a lit X-ray viewer showing the bones of a hand and wrist. She points a pen at a thin dark line running across one of the bones. The young man beside her leans in and looks at the line on the film. He then sits back with his forearm in a thick white plaster cast held up in a blue sling, winces, and holds the casted arm against his chest.

A woman in a cream blouse sits at a desk in a busy open-plan office with a monitor, keyboard and paper coffee cup in front of her. She presses her fingertips against both temples and moves them in small circles, screwing up her face. She keeps pressing, moving her hands up over her forehead and into her hair, then lowers her head into her hands and finally lays her head down on her folded arms on the desk while colleagues work behind her.

A nurse in teal scrubs pushes a supply trolley down a bright hospital corridor while colleagues wave at her. At a bedside she holds a forehead thermometer to a middle-aged male patient's temple and reads it. She shakes out his pillow and slides it back behind his head, and he laughs. In close-up she winds a white bandage around his wrist above the drip line. Finally she holds up a small bottle of juice for him and he grins back at her.

In a bright clinic room a queue of young people wait their turn. A young man pulls his sleeve up and grins over his shoulder while a syringe goes into his upper arm, then shows the round plaster stuck on the spot; a young woman in a black top takes hers the same way and points at her plaster; a woman in glasses gets her injection next; at the end the whole group lines up facing the camera and taps the plasters on their bare arms.

Gym-goers come out of a glass gym door in sportswear, walking stiff-legged and grimacing. A man in a grey T-shirt holds the door and winces as he steps down, and a blonde woman in leggings hobbles out after him. A woman with curly hair lowers herself onto a street bench with her face screwed up, then sits rubbing her legs. At the end the whole group waddles down the pavement together with straight, sore legs.

A young blonde woman with a plaited ponytail stands on the open rear deck of a ferry, holding the handrail with the ship's white wake stretching away behind her across a cold blue sea. Her face is screwed up and she clamps both hands over her mouth, swallowing hard. She keeps her hands there, breathing through them, then gives up standing and sits down on the deck bench, doubled forward with both hands still pressed over her mouth while other passengers stand at the rail further back.

A team in blue scrubs, caps, masks and white gloves stands around a draped patient on an operating table under a large round surgical lamp. One of them leans over the opening in the drapes and works with instruments while the others hold retractors. A woman looks up at the camera as a scalpel is passed hand to hand over a metal tray; a heart monitor beside the table shows the pulse trace and the numbers 190, 20 and 99. The team keeps working around the table, then all of them look up at the camera and give a thumbs up.

A young man in a dark red bomber jacket walks into a small pharmacy past a lit green cross. At the counter he holds out a folded white slip of paper to the pharmacist in a white coat, who reads it, turns to the wall of medicine boxes behind her and picks out the packet the paper asks for. She comes back and hands him the medicine across the glass counter, and he takes it and smiles.

Two young women in gardening dungarees sit on a wooden bench in a green garden. One of them, red-haired, screws her face up in pain and holds out her bare forearm, which is covered in a patch of angry red blotchy spots, and scratches at it with her fingers. Her friend uncaps a white tube of cream and squeezes a blob onto the red patch, then it is rubbed into a white circle over the spots. The red-haired one winces and grimaces at the sting while her friend laughs beside her.

In a bright clinic a physiotherapist holds up a model of the human spine and shows it to a young man in a grey T-shirt, moving her finger along the vertebrae. She then points at his lower back, has him raise his arms and stretch, and he turns to the camera smiling.

In a bright clinic waiting room a nurse in a white coat holds up a small glass vial and shows it to a young man in a green t-shirt sitting on a chair. She swabs his upper arm and pushes the needle of a syringe into it while he watches and smiles. A round plaster is stuck on the spot, and he stands up and flexes his bicep proudly while other patients wait in the background.

In a bright kitchen a young woman in a grey sports top tips an orange jar labelled with a vitamin label and shakes a large white tablet into her palm. She drops the tablet into a tall glass of water on the counter; it fizzes hard, filling the glass with bubbles until the water turns bright orange. She stares at the glass with wide eyes, then lifts it, drinks, and pulls a satisfied face. A bowl of oranges and kiwis sits beside her.

At a funfair a young man staggers away from a spinning teacup ride with his hand clamped over his mouth and his eyes bulging. He hurries to a grey bin and doubles over it. More riders come off the ride the same way: a young woman covers her mouth with both hands, another man clamps his hand over his and bends forward, and soon a whole row of people is bent over the bins along the walkway while the carousel and the big wheel keep turning behind them.

Inside an orange mountain tent at night in a snowstorm, lit by a hanging lantern, a young woman in a blue puffer jacket and a headband with a head torch kneels and reads the round dial of a gauge in her hand. It is connected to a grey cuff wrapped around the upper arm of a bare-chested young man sitting wrapped in a silver emergency blanket. She looks up at him. A green gas bottle and an ice axe lie on the floor, and a climber crouches in the snowy doorway.

In a village hall decorated with bunting during a baking contest, a man in a green jumper lies dazed on his back across a table of pies and cakes. A young woman in a green cardigan and jeans kneels over him, wrinkling her nose, and holds an open box with a green herb pie right under his nose. He slowly opens his eyes and lifts his head, and she breaks into a delighted smile. A cook in a white hat gasps behind them, a crowd watches, and a cherry pie and a tipped jug of cream sit in front.

At a seaside skatepark at sunset, a young man in a black T-shirt and grey shorts sits on the concrete edge of the bowl, wincing and laughing, while a young woman in a white top and jeans with a long ponytail wraps a white bandage around his scraped knee. She finishes the bandage and then bends down to pick up a spray bottle beside an open green first-aid kit. Wrappers and a skateboard lie on the ground, a small scruffy dog sniffs nearby, and skaters ride behind under a pink sky.

At an outdoor hot spring in snowy mountains, with steam rising in the low winter sun, a young man stands waist-deep in the hot water, laughing, his arms flung wide as a pair of wooden crutches flies through the air above him and falls away. He then walks out through the water towards the camera on his own legs, laughing. Behind him other bathers in the pool raise their arms and cheer. Snow covers the stone edge and the pine trees, and monkeys sit on the roof of a wooden bathhouse.

Inside a simple village clinic with bare walls and sunlight coming through a window, a smiling young nurse in a pale blue uniform, a white headscarf, a stethoscope and blue gloves reaches into a blue cool box full of ice on the table, takes out a small glass vial of medicine and holds it up high. A young man in a motorbike helmet stands behind her, and villagers crowd at the open door, some raising their hands and cheering. Health posters hang on the wall.

A hospital rooftop helipad at sunset. A young woman doctor in a white coat over navy scrubs, a stethoscope around her neck, runs towards a red and white helicopter with its rotor spinning, carrying a red medical bag. Behind her a nurse in blue scrubs runs too as papers fly away in the wind from the blades. At the helicopter, crew members wait in the open door and others bring a stretcher. A city skyline glows pink and orange in the background.

Inside a hospital emergency department at night, paramedics in dark uniforms and blue gloves push a patient on a wheeled stretcher through the glass entrance doors, one squeezing a breathing bag. A young nurse in navy scrubs runs beside them, and a doctor in a white coat pulls on gloves in a side doorway. Behind the glass blue and red lights flash in the dark, and worried relatives stand in the waiting area. An empty wheelchair stands on the right and a pair of gloves lies on the floor.

A young woman sits at a kitchen table by a window in morning light. She has long brown hair and a grey sweatshirt and holds up an insulin pen, checking the dose. She then lifts her sweatshirt, injects into her belly and looks at the pen again. On the table are a plate of rice and beans, an open blue cool bag holding two small glass vials, a blood sugar meter, a small plastic cap and a notebook with handwritten numbers. A young man sits behind her eating from a bowl and smiles at her.

A dim clinic room lit by a desk lamp. A young woman with long red hair lies on an examination couch in a navy T-shirt, while a smiling young woman in navy scrubs holds an ultrasound probe against her side and points at the screen of the ultrasound machine, which shows a grey bean-shaped kidney. The patient looks at the screen, and the woman in scrubs then turns to her and smiles. A poster with two red kidneys stands behind them, and a bottle of gel and a paper towel roll sit on a metal trolley in front.

A sandy beach on a bright day. A young woman lifeguard in a yellow jacket and red swimsuit kneels in the sand and presses down again and again with both hands on the chest of a grey training dummy, practising heart massage, sand flying up. A young man lifeguard in red shorts kneels beside her and counts with his hands raised. Another lifeguard in a red swimsuit jogs out of the waves towards them, past a lifeguard tower, rescue boards and colourful umbrellas.

A bright dental clinic. A young woman in a lilac top lies back in a blue dentist's chair, laughing with her mouth wide open. A student in a white coat and blue gloves holds a small dental mirror at her teeth. All around them, young students in teal and grey scrubs lean in to watch; some laugh and cover their mouths, and one holds up a model of a set of teeth. Cabinets, a big round lamp and a window with a tree are behind them.

An old-fashioned pharmacy with dark wooden shelves full of glass apothecary jars and brown medicine bottles, green hanging lamps and brass scales on a marble counter. Behind the counter a grey tabby cat in a white coat counts small white pills on a blue counting tray with a spatula, next to a small brown pill bottle, and then picks up the bottle. On the other side a hare in a red and white striped scarf, dusted with snow, waits with its paws on the counter. Snow falls outside the window.

A bright bedroom with a carved arch and patterned tiles, seen as a selfie. A smiling young woman with curly hair in a cream cardigan sits up in bed under a knitted blanket, holding up a mug and looking well again. A beagle walks across the bed, sniffs and licks her face, and she sips from her mug. Behind her a blonde woman in a blue jumper opens the curtains to let the sunshine in, and a man in a mustard T-shirt clears a bedside table and then stands smiling.

A bedroom on a rainy day. A young man with messy dark hair, in a white T-shirt, sits up in bed and blows his nose into a tissue, with used tissues on the bed and bedside table. A golden retriever in a light blue nurse's tunic stands on its hind legs beside the bed holding a tray with orange juice and a bowl of soup. The young man takes the tray and smiles at the dog. A white coat and a black apron hang on the door, a plant stands at the window and black shoes lie on the floor.

A bright operating theatre with white tiled walls and a large metal operating lamp overhead. A young woman in green scrubs, a green cap and white gloves leans over an operating table covered with a green sheet and carefully works on a teddy bear with fine tweezers, a little white stuffing beside it. A young man in scrubs and a face mask stands next to her holding a metal dish. At the end she smiles. A tray of instruments lies on the table.

A training room with a steel table. A young man in maroon scrubs, a maroon cap and magnifying glasses practises stitching with forceps and thread on a banana laid on a green cloth. A laughing young woman in light blue scrubs, a navy cap and blue gloves sits beside him and claps her gloved hands, sending up a small puff of powder. In front of them lie a steel tray of shiny instruments and a tissue box, and behind them a man in teal scrubs adjusts a large round operating lamp.

A crowded university lecture hall in winter with wooden benches and globe lamps. In the front row a young woman in a cream beanie and a green scarf coughs with her eyes screwed shut, then blows her nose into a tissue, crumpled tissues piled on the desk in front of her. A young man behind her pulls his jumper over his nose, a young woman on the right squirts hand sanitiser onto her hands, and a young woman behind leans so far away that she ends up lying across the bench.
